method: Original Z-Anatomy FBX leader endpoints converted from local Z-up to glTF local Y-up. Each parent mesh bounding box matched before its landmarks were admitted. No invented points. Landmarks are pins, not segmented surface regions.
limitations: Ilium, ischium and pubis have source pins but do not have separately segmented meshes.
Reference-only structures are excluded from scored 3D quizzes.
Find-the-structure questions use a small spatial neighborhood of source pins, not a complete segmented landmark surface.
